text: This report recommends the 2025 meeting schedule for the Property Standards Committee - Scarborough Panel. The proposed schedule is guided by City Council's approved schedule, and the availability of virtual meeting space.

The Property Standards Committee - Scarborough Panel: 1. Approved the following 2025 meeting dates: Thursday, January 16, 2025 Thursday, February 27, 2025 Friday, March 21, 2025 Tuesday, April 22, 2025 Friday, May 16, 2025 Thursday, June 26, 2025 Thursday, July 24, 2025 Thursday, September 11, 2025 Thursday, October 09, 2025 Thursday, November 06, 2025 Friday, December 12, 2025
